author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell reacts to Andy Burnham's political speech, questioning whether his carefully timed pauses and emotional delivery are genuine or simply another performance. He mocks the awkward moments when applause fails to arrive and argues that politicians shouldn't be celebrated for promising to do the bare minimum.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell reacts to Andy Burnham's emotional speech about his father, questioning whether sentimental political messaging is enough in today's world. He argues that modern politics increasingly resembles advertising, with governments, politicians, and even their speeches packaged and sold to the public like products.
